story.iWant: well-defined base plugin interfaces with lifecycle hooks
story.soThat: I can implement plugins that integrate properly with the Holo platform
story.tasks: - Define IPlugin base interface with lifecycle methods - Implement optional lifecycle hooks - Create PluginContext types - Define error handling patterns - Add plugin state management - Document all interfaces with JSDoc - Create base abstract class - Add plugin metadata interface

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - IPlugin interface fully defined with initialize/destroy methods - Optional lifecycle hooks implemented (onBeforeInitialize, onAfterInitialize, etc.) - Plugin context types with logger, config, and environment access - Error handling types and patterns defined - Plugin state management interface - JSDoc documentation for all interfaces - Usage examples in comments - Base abstract class implementing common functionality - Plugin metadata interface for runtime introspection - Validation that interfaces compile without errors

item.title: Product Requirements Document
item.snippet: FR1: IPlugin base interface with initialize(), destroy() lifecycle methods. FR2: PluginContext passed to initialize() with logger, config, environment

item.title: Plugin System Architecture
item.snippet: Rich Lifecycle with Context: IPlugin with initialize(context), destroy(). Ensures AI agent consistency, context injection for dependencies

item.title: Epic 2: Common SDK Package
item.snippet: IPlugin interface with manifest, initialize(context), destroy(), getState(), healthCheck() methods

item.title: CLAUDE Rules
item.snippet: NEVER use 'any' type, always use proper TypeScript types with strict mode

item.reason: Reference for DI patterns using tsyringe @injectable

story-context.constraints: - All lifecycle methods must return Promises (async first) - No use of 'any' type - strict TypeScript - Must support graceful shutdown via destroy() - Configuration hot reload capability via onConfigChange() - Built-in health monitoring support - Design for backward compatibility and future extension - Follow existing tsyringe DI patterns from services - Context injection for all dependencies - PluginState enum: CREATED, INITIALIZING, INITIALIZED, DESTROYING, DESTROYED, ERROR

item.name: IPlugin
item.signature: interface IPlugin { manifest: PluginManifest; initialize(context: PluginContext): Promise<void>; destroy(): Promise<void>; getState(): PluginState; healthCheck(): Promise<HealthCheckResult> }

item.name: PluginContext
item.signature: interface PluginContext { logger: Logger; config: PluginConfig; env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv; registry: IPluginRegistry; events: EventEmitter }

item.name: PluginLifecycle
item.signature: Optional lifecycle hooks: onBeforeInitialize, onAfterInitialize, onBeforeDestroy, onAfterDestroy, onConfigChange, onHealthCheck

tests.standards: Jest unit tests, mock plugin implementations to verify interface contracts, test lifecycle state transitions
tests.ideas: - Test IPlugin interface implementation with mock plugin - Verify lifecycle method calling order - Test state transitions (CREATED -> INITIALIZING -> INITIALIZED) - Test error handling in lifecycle methods - Verify context injection works correctly - Test health check response format - Test graceful shutdown via destroy() - Mock plugin with all optional lifecycle hooks
